source: CDC CVX Public Domain + CDC ACIP Adult Immunization Schedule

vaccines.interval_summary: 2-dose adult series administered 2 to 6 months apart (adults >=50y or >=19y immunodeficient/immunosuppressed)
vaccines.recency_guidance: 1 administered dose represents 1 of 2 required doses (incomplete series until dose 2); prior live Zostavax (CVX 121) does not count toward the 2-dose RZV series.

vaccines.interval_summary: Historical 1-dose live zoster vaccine (discontinued in US)
vaccines.recency_guidance: CDC ACIP recommends the 2-dose recombinant zoster series (Shingrix, CVX 187) even for adults who previously received live Zostavax.
Doses administered >12 months before the chart anchor date reflect historical formulations rather than current-season COVID-19 vaccination.

vaccines.interval_summary: 1 adult Tdap dose (plus 1 Tdap during each pregnancy at 27-36 weeks gestation), followed by Td or Tdap booster every 10 years
vaccines.recency_guidance: Booster due if >=10 years have elapsed since the most recent tetanus-containing dose (or >=5 years for contaminated wound management).

vaccines.interval_summary: Single dose of PCV20 (CVX 216) or PCV21 (CVX 327), or PCV15 followed by PPSV23, for adults >=50y (or 19-49y with qualifying risk conditions)
vaccines.recency_guidance: Adults who received only older PCV13 (CVX 133) or PPSV23 (CVX 33) may require completion per ACIP pneumococcal risk/age rules.

vaccines.interval_summary: 1 dose annually each respiratory virus season
vaccines.recency_guidance: Doses >12 months before the chart anchor date reflect a prior influenza season.

vaccines.interval_summary: Single adult dose for adults >=75y, adults 60-74y at increased risk of severe RSV, or pregnant patients at 32-36 weeks seasonal window
vaccines.recency_guidance: Currently recommended as a single dose rather than an annual revaccination for older adults.

vaccines.interval_summary: 2-dose series (Heplisav-B CVX 189, 1 month apart) or 3-dose series (Engerix-B/Recombivax HB at 0, 1, 6 months)
vaccines.recency_guidance: Verify full 2- or 3-dose series completion depending on product.

vaccines.interval_summary: 2-dose series (if initiated before age 15) or 3-dose series (if initiated at >=15y or immunocompromised)
vaccines.recency_guidance: Routine vaccination through age 26y; shared clinical decision-making ages 27-45y.

vaccines.interval_summary: 1 or 2 lifetime doses for adults born in 1957 or later without evidence of immunity
Adolescent primary/booster schedule or adult risk-based dosing
vaccines.recency_guidance: Boosters every 5 years only if ongoing increased risk persists.
